mapper.select: select site_code, page_code, display_type, metric_code, sort_no, visible, update_by, update_time from dashboard_page_metric_site order by site_code, page_code, display_type, sort_no, metric_code
mapper.delete: delete from dashboard_page_metric_site where upper(site_code) = upper(#{siteCode}) and page_code = #{pageCode} and display_type = #{displayType}
mapper.insert:
insert into dashboard_page_metric_site (site_code, page_code, display_type, metric_code, sort_no, visible, update_by, update_time) values
(#{r.siteCode}, #{r.pageCode}, #{r.displayType}, #{r.metricCode}, #{r.sortNo}, #{r.visible}, #{r.updateBy}, localtimestamp)
